strings.name: Joel Mokyr
strings.role: Economic historian · Technology and growth researcher
strings.summary: Born in the Netherlands, Mokyr moved to Israel as a child, earned a Yale doctorate and taught for decades at Northwestern. Combining economic history, technology history and knowledge diffusion, he examines cultural and institutional conditions for the Industrial Revolution and sustained innovation. His books stress useful knowledge and open exchange, while competing historical explanations remain debated. He shared the 2025 economics Nobel with Aghion and Howitt.
